answer: Collateral here sits in an exclusive escrow: each deposit enters through one inlet keyed to a single address, and the ledger refuses any second account citing the same coins. With a 50 POA bond, 1,000 fakes must lock 50,000 POA, not 50 reused 1,000 times. Every bond carries an ember tag, a hash of its funding output; a gale sweep each epoch re-checks all tags, and a reused one slashes both bonds. Colluders pooling funds gain nothing, since a coin backs one identity at a time. An honest agent posts one bond and recovers it on exit.
